interfaces.name: hip_yaw_left
interfaces.what: Ø19.0 hole the left hip-yaw XL330's horn hub passes down through; the joint axis (MJCF left_hip_yaw, body (6, +17.5), -z) is this hole's axis after the 90 deg mesh->body turn. Servo body sits on the +z face, the 22x16x4 idler bearing (mesh-placements: z -5 in body) below.
interfaces.source: MEASURED off trunk_base.stl by cecad.meshfeatures (Ø19.0 at (17.5, -2.0)), 2026-09-01

interfaces.name: hip_yaw_right
interfaces.what: Ø19.0 hole for the right hip-yaw XL330 (MJCF right_hip_yaw, body (6, -17.5)); mirror of hip_yaw_left about x = 0.
interfaces.source: MEASURED off trunk_base.stl by cecad.meshfeatures (Ø19.0 at (-17.5, -2.0)), 2026-09-01
